rule: the structure's head term (side words, ordinals and "part of ..." removed; e.g. "acromial part of left deltoid" -> "deltoid", "left fifth rib" -> "rib") must appear, every word, in the LAST segment of a StatPearls "Anatomy, ..." or "Neuroanatomy, ..." chapter title (singular/plural ignored), with at most 3 other words in that segment. The closest title wins (fewest extra words). With no chapter of its own, the nearest ancestor in the BodyParts3D part-of tree that has one is used, and the app says so. No match -> nothing is shown; nothing is written by a model.
